name: Config Features
description: Packages selected configuration into a per-feature folder so it can be exported from one Drupal site and imported into another, reconciling UUID differences so matching config is updated rather than duplicated. A Config Split-derived split/merge engine branded for cross-site config sharing.
project_description: Config Features modules helps to share set of selected configurations (called as a Feature here) with any other Drupal sites. This module will take care UUID differences of same configuration being imported to a site. In other words, it will simply update the same configuration though it coming from a different site.
